g.text: FSH-H/I/S/E -> local ASCENT -> QNT / Lean; source and native gates OPEN

text.tspan: incoming-root
Origin must remain in a valid
generated/saved/registered/nonmoving root until frame
publication; arbitrary raw movable C input is rejected
descriptor
Native allocation may fail before taking over custody;
initialize descriptor and cells before publication; no
GC allocation in preparing region
intent
Accepted operation gets stable
VM/owner/domain/activation identity before admission
cutoff; an old accepted preparation may finish
publishing after cutoff
rc-payload
Provisional candidate and existing committed RC
payload are separate scan slots; registration on
processor 1 cannot rely on processor-zero-only mark_rc
publication
Fully initialized mutable root cells become collector-
visible before dropping origin custody; descriptor
publication is not application commit
lease-conversion
Mutable preparation no longer blocks GC once scannable
frame and stop record are accepted; storage pin
remains owned without excluding scanner writeback
participant
Park means no root mutation, not an OS wait that
prevents the processor from running the selected GC
sync operation
scan-root
Collector uses admitted VM adapters including nonzero
owner and rewrites all moved slot values; marker
still-body scan composes with base root model
reload
Resume acquire-observes GC completion and reloads
cell; rejects stale epoch/generation or stale C local
before initializing marker
marker
Marker allocation follows handoff; initial #f body
then current rooted proc; transfer accepted only with
initialized externally held still marker
outcome
Committed receipt and known terminal guard are
distinct from response delivery; unknown running
operation must still park before a later GC
continuation
Root reachability does not revive a killed C
activation; restored continuation cannot reuse retired
frame capability; new execution receives new operation
identity
reserve-before-borrow
Reserve stable native root-frame storage before
dropping any existing root; failure leaves origin
custody; reject incoming movable C value without an
admissible source root
publish-before-join
Accepted intent initializes root cells without
allocation and release-publishes them through VM
enrollment gate; root-frame publication is not commit
of the target RC payload
reclassify-lease
Before requesting allocating GC, convert mutable-
preparation lease to scan-ready custody and stop the
attached context; collector waits for preparation
closure and parked participants, not operation return
scan-and-reload
Collector scans all admitted VM domains including
processor 1 and writes moved values back; owner
reloads through current-epoch cell before marker
initialization or RC commit
guard-and-retire
Failure and supported unwind retain frame until
acknowledged terminal outcome, native/reader pins and
nested children settle; unknown result is neither
quiescence nor permission to free
origin-transfer
Do not withdraw origin before a collector-visible root
frame has custody
preparation
Preparation must terminate without allocating;
acknowledged abort preserves original root, unknown
preparation remains blocking
gc-join
All live activations parked or safely delegated before
freeze; collector never waits for operation completion
marker-exit
Guard catches admitted runtime unwind, invalidates
marker, records error, retains frame until cleanup is
known
native-pin
Native pin prevents unlink/free through ordinary
release and whole-processor cleanup; it is not a GC-
exclusion lease
nested-child
Parent descriptor remains while child activation is
live; no stack address resurrection on repeated
continuation restore
reader-drain
Close new readers and drain accepted metadata/storage
pins before withdrawal; raw value readers require
attached-context safepoints
cycle-removal
Finite model reaches collector freeze while operation
outcome is pending; native lock/progress refinement
remains open
root-reuse
O(k) retained slots per live activation; reuse of
frame does not eliminate tracing or root scanning
modern-c
C can implement all required mechanisms; neither Zig
defer nor a reference count alone handles Gambit
nonlocal unwind or whole-PSTATE cleanup
